metrics.name: drc_boards_evaluated
metrics.note: Floor raised 54->56: two QA boards that previously hit the per-board DRC timeout (issue21482, issue22475) now complete within budget on this run -- not a code change in this round, just a quieter machine/run; left as a floor raise rather than a fluke since the harness's own watchdog logic is unchanged.

metrics.name: drc_precision
metrics.note: Floor raised 0.0592->0.0798: GAPS.md #10's track_width bug is fixed this round -- the board-wide minimum-width constraint (KiCad's bds.m_TrackMinWidth, from .kicad_pro's rules.min_track_width) was being conflated with the net class's own nominal width, which alone produced ~2900 false positives on issue11814. track_width is now 0 extra board-wide (was 2989); the same nominal-vs-minimum fix also applies to via_diameter/hole-size minimums and adds a real board-wide clearance floor (bds.m_MinClearance). The remaining dominant over-firing (clearance/shorting_items/hole_clearance) is diagnosed in detail (see GAPS.md #3's latest update) but not yet fixed -- precision would be higher still once that lands. This run also newly includes two previously-timing-out boards (issue21482, issue22475), which partly offsets the precision gain with their own pre-existing tracks_crossing/clearance issues (see REPORT.md).

metrics.name: drc_recall
metrics.note: Floor raised 0.1231->0.1699, same cause as drc_precision's note: track_width's fix (GAPS.md #10) stopped suppressing real matches behind a wrong constraint, and two more boards now complete. See drc_precision's note and GAPS.md #3 for what's still open.
